name: pass_receiver_input_source
runtime_source_kind: ROM-derived instruction/data spans plus live source RAM; no emulator state as input

spans.name: pass_receiver_handler_and_direction_delta_table
spans.role: Contains the $D80F post-input body, $D84E direction delta table, and $D852 selection routine.

spans.name: receiver_candidate_scan
spans.role: Scans global player slots, compares the ROM-derived $CDE2 tile index to $0624, writes candidate slots, and requests the matching descriptor redraw.

spans.name: player_record_pointer_resolver
spans.role: Doubles the live global slot and resolves its $0300+$0C*slot player-record address through $CD89.

spans.name: player_record_pointer_table
spans.role: Twenty-two little-endian pointers to the live player records at $0300+$0C*slot.

spans.name: coordinate_to_field_tile_helper
spans.role: Maps live X/Y record bytes to the field tile index; out-of-field coordinates return $FF.

decoded_poll_contract.entry_meaning: Post-$CB0F input-latch boundary; $001C/$001E are the current polled pad masks.
decoded_poll_contract.confirm_selection_branch: $D852 selects the single live candidate $0431 when $0625=$01, stores $05FC, copies $0624 to $0638, then returns carry set.

boundary.renderer_calls: Returned as pending source events; EF7F/PPU writes are not executed by this component.
boundary.holder_transfer: Not executed; the executor stops at $D70C entry.
boundary.cycle_timing: Not modeled. FCEUX frame/cycle values are validation observations only.
